During the current .NET development,  I have been working with a senior project architect and 9 other developers. We are using  the Agile/Scrum methodology. We use user-stories and do weekly sprint. Each individual is responsible to develop a feature from front-end to all the way to database with the guidance from the senior project architect. Then, move on to the next feature. We are holding Scrum meeting everyday and we are using Trello cards to keep track of the progress. I have been using all of the modern web development technology extensively on a daily basis for almost a year. Because of this developmental approach we use, I have a very strong full-stack skill set.  I also have prior 5 years of non-web-related professional software engineering experience. positions.title: 1-2. Full Stack .Net Web Developer - Detail
positions.description:
•	Developed address and company information front-end view using HTML, CSS, Razor, jQuery and Bootstrap. Developed mid-tier interface using C#, ADO.NET, and REST client. Developed back-end with database tables and stored procedures using T-SQL. Migrated this feature to AngularJS.
•	Developed company profile update front-end view using HTML, CSS, Razor, jQuery and Bootstrap. Developed mid-tier interface using C#, ADO.NET, and REST client. Developed back-end with database tables and stored procedures using T-SQL. Utilized Dropzone plug-in and Amazon AWS API to load company logo in the front-end view. Migrated this feature to AngularJS.
•	Developed map utility front-end view to search for 'buyers within a given radius' using Google Map API. The math was done in the back-end with T-SQL. The front-end view was implemented using HTML, CSS, Razor, jQuery and Bootstrap. Developed mid-tier interface using C# and REST client. Implemented string address conversion to latitude/longitude format in service using C#. Implemented ‘search by radius’ stored procedure in T-SQL. Utilized jQuery and/or AngularJS DataTable to list the search result. Utilized chosen plug-in for dropdown list. Migrated this feature to AngularJS. Developed an AngularJS directive to print the ‘search by radius’ list.
•	Developed check-out front-end view using Braintree Credit Card/PayPal Payments API. The front-end view was implemented using HTML, CSS, Razor, jQuery and Bootstrap. Developed mid-tier interface using C#. Migrated this feature to AngularJS.
•	Enhanced front-end user admin view by implementing server side pagination with dynamic search and sorting by columns. The server side pagination took big load off the database. The front-end was implemented using dir-paginate plug-in. Utilized C# and ADO.NET datatable type and T-SQL user-defined table type. Developed mid-tier interface using C# and REST client. Developed database tables and stored procedures using T-SQL. Migrated this feature to AngularJS.

positions.title: 2. Hackathon Participant
positions.description: I built crop yield prediction model. To predict individual independent variables (temperature, precipitation, NDVI), I used moving averages. To predict future crop yield (dependent variable), I used Extreme Optimization library (Math and Statistics Numerical Libraries for .NET) to do multiple linear regression analysis by plugging in the future independent variables.
